title: Staging contract test report – billing API v2 (manual run)

definitions.meaning: The release candidate may not be handed to customer testers until the blocking issue is fixed and re-tested.

context_note: Manual re-run triggered at 09:05 after the nightly run skipped this stage (see D03).
content:
Manual run of stage staging-contract-tests for 3.2.0-rc4, started 09:05, finished 09:26.

Result: FAILED. 12 of 19 contract tests passed, 7 failed. All 7 failures occur on /v2/invoices and /v2/payments endpoints with HTTP 401 Unauthorized. The sandbox credentials configured in staging appear to be scoped for API v1 only.

Impact: release candidate rc4 is BLOCKED for UAT until valid v2 sandbox credentials are installed and the contract tests pass. Engineering estimates half a day of re-testing once credentials arrive.

Raised by QA at 09:28. Notified: Engineering lead, Solution architect, PMO.
